scope: Five saved-mix HTTP routes in the existing authenticated Duet handler; no Store/archive/UI/security transport changes.

runtime.service: Actual create_server, real loopback HTTP sockets, real SQLite Store, owned ephemeral ports and temporary directories; no media worker used.

admission.authorization: Existing participant Bearer authentication before JSON body parsing; media cookies do not authorize mutations. Store reauth remains unchanged.
admission.json: Existing exact-key JSON parser, duplicate-key/nonfinite rejection and framing policy reused.
admission.name: Literal 1..80 Unicode code points, non-whitespace-only, NUL-free and UTF-8 encodable; no trim or HTML interpretation.
admission.transport: Existing Host/Origin/setup/TLS/CSRF/body deadlines and bounded private-safe error envelopes unchanged.

verification.reason: New routes absent:404 where the frozen success/admission contract requires 201/400/413.
Routes and strict admission present; valid requests 500 while Store saved-mix methods were still missing. This was an unpublished in-progress dependency state, not a published regression.

failure.classification: Approved new export schema; existing compatibility assertion requires root-owned adaptation. Old test was not edited by route owner.

verification.command: Python ast.parse on duet/server.py and tests/test_saved_mix_http.py

coverage: Two-seat real save/update/rename/delete lifecycle and literal captured labels.
Explicit load pauses at first available entry/zero, increments current revisions and rejects old transport command.
Deleted references require explicit boolean consent; saved original labels/order remain unchanged; all-unavailable refuses.
Stale expected library/playlist revisions refuse without snapshot mutation or automatic retry.
Exact keys, duplicate JSON keys, safe integers, malformed Unicode/NUL/whitespace/+1 names, exact 80-emoji admission.
Eight distinct saved mixes with repeated names accepted; ninth and empty-current update refuse atomically.
Capability and same-origin requirements,64 KiB + 1 body refusal, no-store response and unknown well-formed mix 404.
limitations: Only new focused HTTP tests and relevant existing server tests were run by this owner. Root owns whole Python/static/browser/maximum/CI gates.
The focused tests use loopback mode; existing TLS transport is untouched, and new route TLS end-to-end acceptance is a separate root/native gate.
No source media decode or encoding is needed for route tests; actual audio/archive acceptance is separate.
Existing suite mixed result is preserved honestly until root adapts the intentional schema assertion.
cleanup: Each unittest owns its temporary library and ephemeral service, calls shutdown/server_close and joins/asserts thread termination. No pre-existing service/browser/data directory was touched.
